profile.summary: I’m a Software Engineer with a background in physics who is seeking new ways to solve problems and bring people together. positions.title: Web Development Immersive
positions.description:
General Assembly’s Web Development Immersive (WDI) is a 12-week long training program
dedicated to providing students a deep dive into the world of web development, focusing on web development tools and best practices. Utilized skills such as Git/Github,
HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Node, MongoDB, Django and SQL to create a portfolio of work including a full-stack web application for reviewing restaurant menu items.

Provided leadership and coordination to the science department.

Led the science department in instructional innovations and methods to engage students in authentic, challenging work toward deeper learning of the curriculum.

projects.title: YS Playlist Tool
projects.description:
This is my capstone project from General Assembly's Web Development Immersive program.  I used React to make a single page application to make building playlists on Spotify for fitness classes easier.  Shortly before starting General Assembly's WDI program, I got certified to teach yoga sculpt classes.  A big part of teaching those classes is choosing the playlist to guide you through class.  

With my app, users can log in with their Spotify accounts, search for songs by title or artist and see relevant data such as BPM and duration.  If the song fits they can click a button and add it to a playlist. 
 On the far right, there is a card that shows the recommended guidelines for CorePower's Yoga Sculpt sections and the playlist they are adding to.  When they are done, they can save the playlist into their Spotify account.
